title: Certified Payroll Report (Oregon BOLI WH-38)
description: A prevailing-wage certified payroll: the payroll/certified statement a contractor files with the public agency for each pay period on a public works project, listing every worker's classification, daily hours, rates, fringe benefits, gross and net pay, followed by the signed statement of compliance.

form_number.description: Form identifier as printed, e.g. WH-38.

is_prime_contractor.description: True if the 'PRIME CONTRACTOR' box is marked (an X), false if the 'SUBCONTRACTOR' box is marked instead.

is_final_payroll.description: True if the 'FINAL PAYROLL' box is checked, false if it is empty.

contractor.description: The contractor filing this payroll, from the header block.

phone.description: Contractor phone number beside 'Phone' in the header, as printed.

street_address.description: Full street address line including city, state and ZIP.

mailing_address.description: Full mailing address line including city, state and ZIP.

project.description: The public works project the payroll covers.

pay_period_began.description: Date beside 'Date Pay Period Began', as YYYY-MM-DD.

pay_period_ended.description: Date beside 'Date Pay Period Ended', as YYYY-MM-DD.

prime_contractor_section.description: The 'THIS SECTION FOR PRIME CONTRACTORS ONLY' block. Each field is null when its line is blank.

public_agency_phone.description: Phone number printed under the agency name in this section.

date_first_advertised.description: Date Contract Specifications First Advertised for Bid, as YYYY-MM-DD.

contract_amount.description: Contract Amount in dollars, as a number without $ or commas.

subcontractor_section.description: The 'THIS SECTION FOR SUBCONTRACTORS ONLY' block. Each field is null when its line is blank.

subcontract_amount.description: Subcontract Amount in dollars. Null if the line is blank; do not return 0 for a blank line.

day_columns.description: The day-and-date header of column (3), left to right, one entry per day column.

weekday.description: Weekday abbreviation as printed (M, T, W, Th, F, Sa, Su).

date.description: Month/day as printed beneath the weekday, e.g. 2/4.

workers.description: One entry per filled worker block in the payroll grid, top to bottom. Skip empty blocks.

name.description: Worker's name, the first line of column (1).

address.description: Worker's address from column (1), street and city lines joined with a comma.

classification.description: Column (2) classification including group, e.g. 'Carpenter Gp 1'.

apprentice_level.description: Apprenticeship step printed under the classification, e.g. '60% Apprentice'. Null if none.

straight_time_hours_by_day.description: Hours on the ST row for each day column, left to right; null where the cell is blank.

overtime_hours_by_day.description: Hours on the OT row for each day column, left to right; null where the cell is blank.

total_straight_time_hours.description: Column (4) TOTAL HOURS on the ST row.

total_overtime_hours.description: Column (4) TOTAL HOURS on the OT row; null if blank.

straight_time_rate.description: Column (5) HOURLY BASE RATE on the ST row.

overtime_rate.description: Column (5) HOURLY BASE RATE on the OT row.

fringe_paid_as_wages.description: Column (6) hourly fringe benefit amount paid as wages to the employee.

gross_this_project.description: Column (7) GROSS AMOUNT EARNED: the upper-left half of the diagonally split cell, the gross earned on this project.

gross_wages_all_work.description: Column (7) GROSS AMOUNT EARNED: the lower-right half of the diagonally split cell, the total gross for all work in the period.

work_schedule.description: Schedule line at the bottom of the block, e.g. 'Reg Hrly Schd: 8am- 4:30pm'.

fringe_benefits_paid_to_plans.description: Columns (10) and (11) beside this worker's block: each hourly fringe benefit paid to a benefit party, plan, fund or program.

plan.description: Column (11) name of the benefit party, plan, fund or program, e.g. 'Med - BC/BS'.

certified_statement.description: The CERTIFIED STATEMENT on the reverse of the form.

date.description: Date at the top of the statement, as YYYY-MM-DD.

contractor_name.description: Contractor, subcontractor or surety named in item (1).

building_or_work.description: Building or work named in item (1).

permissible_deductions.description: Deductions described below item (1), as printed.

fringe_benefits_to_approved_plans_checke.description: True if box 4(a), fringe benefits paid to approved plans, funds or programs, is checked.

fringe_benefits_in_cash_checked.description: True if box 4(b), fringe benefits paid in cash, is checked.
